title: Diagnose the Scaffold Before You Shop the Model | A Cinematic Research Brief
base_title: Diagnose the Scaffold Before You Shop the Model
description:
Many reasoning failures blamed on the model are really failures in the scaffold wrapped around it.

This cinematic brief centers the architectural move behind good reasoning systems: diagnose the scaffold, the memory path, and the planning loop before treating model choice as the bottleneck.

It should work as a clean entry point for builders tired of benchmark-first reasoning talk.
